title: Worth every cent!
text: Wow wow wow! My husband and I decided to spoil ourselves with some authentic Spanish culture and we were not disappointed! The flamenco show was incredible, I felt every beat and step. And the tapas were super tasty. Luke was also a fantastic guide and made the whole experience even more enjoyable. High recommend!
author: LolMartens

title: Food, history and Alfredo!
text: Alfredo not only introduced us to amazing food, we learned more about Barcelonas history!  Alfredo was very friendly, knowledgeable and professional. We are here before a cruise to experience Barcelona and this tour did not disappoint.  If you can book Alfredo, do it!
author: 411jenniferL

title: Great experience with wonderful food and flamenco show

title: Alfredo knocked our socks off.  He is a humorist, a professor of Catalon history and culture. You will not be sorry ever
